title: Preserve an ordinary withheld predecessor's outcome through an adopted successor's root drift
outcome: A retained ordinary predecessor with withheld source attribution can deliver its outcome to the exact still-held claim after a runtime-adopted successor and a canonical root change, while refusing a lost owner.
acceptance: A behavioral fixture starts an ordinary multi-root turn with A's exact outcome owner and attribution withheld, acknowledges B, lets an adopted successor apply B before capture, then changes A's canonical root while A remains exactly held. A receives its outcome only. Source and check evidence stay local.

The matched fixture removes A or changes its claim fence. Delivery refuses the old outcome and retains the existing local diagnostic. Existing adopted predecessor and ordinary outcomes remain correct.
